inputCensus.reason: These are separate editorial identification of biblical texts and episodes described in Lanslots without printed chapter-and-verse; some repeat themes already in canonical research. No claim of 107 distinct citations.

qualityGates: Every entry must have source context matched against original archived OCR, with its original raw line and a Bible chapter/verse specifically marked as editorially supplied.
The 16 verse assignments do not imply that Lanslots printed them or authored those verses.
Some interpretations infer more than the text of Scripture proves (Magi as first use, Roman ceremonial origins, precise Cross form, Eucharist at Emmaus), which must be qualified.
Do not create new Guide, modify 1962 rubrics or insert inline cues automatically.
Independent complete Catholic Bible/textual review and original PDF page-image verification still required.
